declare
  v_amt number;
  v_id  number;
begin
  for i in 1 .. 300 loop
    v_id := trunc(dbms_random.value(1, 20000));
    select amount into v_amt from mtk_cust where id = v_id;
  end loop;
  for i in 1 .. 300 loop
    v_id := trunc(dbms_random.value(1, 100000));
    select amount into v_amt from mtk_orders where id = v_id;
  end loop;
end;
